phase3_findings.description: phase-0-setup.md 0.4's three refusal arms set no source token, so Phase 4 reports 'neither surface carried criteria' about a run that consulted neither surface (Unknown-is-not-zero), and falsifies the diff-added 'degradation stays visible' sentence
_acs_pr_identity_ok's `return bool(decisions)` is existential over the whole record set and an empty base64 payload decodes cleanly, so one junk record licenses dropping every criterion
_bind_scope_decisions adopts a previous run's orphaned pr=pending records into this PR
the 'three such writers' trust argument meets its own falsifier: phase-1-setup's two --replace-acs-file mirrors emit no record
phase-4-verdict.md's headline scope clause has no defined value when divergence is not-applicable, so an agent emits 'scope unchanged' for a run that never read the workpad
phase-3-review.md's 'clean no-op' claim is false — --bind-scope-decisions is a non-checkpoint mutation that PATCHes and bumps Last updated
agents/checklist-verifier.md's category enum was not updated with issue_acceptance alongside the generator — a coupled-invariant break that reaches every rank-1 item
_fail's exit-code comment ('Only cmd_status ... Every other caller keeps exit 1') is falsified by this diff's three new exit-3 callers; same drift in _find_workpad_comment's docstring
section_parse.extract_section's duplicate-heading docstring is false in both halves — a same-level duplicate terminates the parse, a deeper duplicate concatenates
cmd_acs_resolve's 'Exit 3 is reserved for a failure to read the issue body' is contradicted by its own opening _require_section_parse, which also exits 3
_render_md_line's shared-constant rationale overstates what the constant prevents — writer uses containment, reader uses suffix, so a mid-string tag escapes both
the undecodable-payload assertion is vacuous — the !!!! fixture is grammar-rejected by the payload charset class and never reaches _unb64
acs-resolve with --pr omitted (the current-branch arm this change created) is never executed by any test; the prose is pinned but the behaviour is not
_acs_fetch_issue_body's exit-3 path is untested — the gh stub has no issue-read failure knob
--emit-source-token is only exercised on shapes yielding zero criteria, so the composed token+criteria output ordering is unasserted
_acs_diverge's '(unrecorded new text)' fallback wording is unpinned and can rot into a bare 'CHANGED: A -> '
